'''Callosian spring vegetable soup''' was a type of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] made with [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> It shared its name with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Callos]] and its inhabitants the [[Callosian]]s.<ref name="Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The soup was sold for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was served on [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxdays]] as part of the diner's [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate specials]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Callosian spring vegetable soup was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
